columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Role-owned durable runtime with verification-gated Digital Employee self-evolution
columns.title_zh: 具有角色所有权与验证门禁自演化的持久数字员工运行时
columns.researchQuestion: How should a persistent Digital Employee runtime separate durable user intent from bounded operational missions, assign role-owned review, gate memory/skill/routing evolution on verification, and escalate when verification cannot close?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: 持久数字员工运行时应如何分离稳定用户意图与有界操作任务，落实角色所有的审查责任，以验证门禁控制 Memory、Skill 与路由演化，并在无法闭环验证时升级给操作员？
columns.reason: Argus is the strongest bounded Digital Employee object in the pool because it directly combines durable state, explicit roles, bounded missions, verification-gated evolution and operator escalation in one primary research artifact.
columns.reason_zh: Argus 是信号池中边界最清晰的数字员工对象：单一主要研究成果同时覆盖持久状态、明确角色、有界 Mission、验证门禁自演化与操作员升级。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on Argus role ownership, durable-state model, mission boundaries, verification gates, operator escalation points, evaluation setup and stated limitations.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查 Argus 的角色所有权、持久状态模型、Mission 边界、验证门禁、操作员升级点、评测设置及作者声明的限制。
columns.proposedCategory: Digital Employee Runtime Governance and Self-Evolution

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Role-aware CPU-GPU scheduling architecture for production agentic workflows
columns.title_zh: 面向生产级 Agentic Workflow 的角色感知 CPU-GPU 调度架构
columns.source_zh: arXiv — Microsoft Azure 生产研究（arXiv:2608.04458）
columns.researchQuestion: What infrastructure architecture is required when production agentic workflows fragment orchestration across CPU and GPU work, exhibit bursty demand, and require role-aware resource scheduling rather than request-level model serving alone?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: 当生产级 Agentic Workflow 在 CPU 与 GPU 之间形成碎片化编排、呈现突发资源需求，并要求角色感知调度而非仅按请求提供模型服务时，需要怎样的基础设施架构？
columns.reason: This is the strongest Industry Architecture object because it uses Microsoft Azure production traces plus controlled framework experiments to expose a bounded resource-orchestration problem at infrastructure scale, not a single product feature.
columns.reason_zh: 这是最强的行业架构对象：研究结合 Microsoft Azure 生产 Trace 与受控框架实验，把问题限定为基础设施尺度的资源编排，而不是单一产品功能。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the production traces, CPU/GPU fragmentation, burst characteristics, role-sensitive demand, scheduling implications, experimental controls and transfer limits.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查生产 Trace、CPU/GPU 碎片化、突发特征、角色敏感需求、调度影响、实验控制与外推边界。
columns.proposedCategory: Agentic Infrastructure and Role-Aware Resource Architecture

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Report-and-materialize lifecycle for deferred agent environment provisioning
columns.title_zh: 延迟 Agent 环境 Provisioning 的报告—实体化生命周期
columns.researchQuestion: How should an agent runtime represent deferred environment provisioning as status reports plus explicit materialization so invalid reports, duplicate materialization and conflicts are bounded by one testable lifecycle?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: Agent 运行时应如何把延迟环境 Provisioning 表示为状态报告加显式实体化，使无效报告、重复实体化与冲突都被约束在一个可测试生命周期中？
columns.reason: This maintainer change exposes a concrete, reproducible lifecycle simplification with explicit conflict and duplicate tests. It directly informs agent-runtime environment state machines, recovery boundaries and observable provisioning semantics.
columns.reason_zh: 该维护者变更给出具体可复现的生命周期收敛方案，并明确覆盖冲突与重复实体化测试，可直接支撑 Agent 运行时环境状态机、恢复边界与可观测 Provisioning 语义。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the EnvironmentManager API change, provisioning state transitions, report validation, pending-environment materialization, conflict handling, tests and compatibility boundary.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查 EnvironmentManager API 变化、Provisioning 状态迁移、报告校验、待定环境实体化、冲突处理、测试与兼容边界。
